approval_source.question_set: Whether the sentry stays an archive node (D12-Q01; host_files.py:549) now that startup no longer grows with its history (user, 13 November 2026: 'proceed with your recommendations on the remaining items')

reason: Staging sentry startup failure of 2026-11-10 (BOUNDED_STARTUP_FAILURE, height 173,074); root cause in draft PR #135, fix in PR #136. Archive made the sentry's startup linear in height; with the checkpoint it is not. Archive still grows the sentry's volume (D12-Q01 rule).

decisions.question: Sentry block history
decisions.selected: Keep archive: the sentry holds every committed block, a second copy of the history on another host
decisions.rule: If archive is kept, the sentry's volume is sized for the archive and its startup relies on the checkpoint; if window, the sentry no longer holds every block and the disaster recovery claim changes.

does_not_authorize: Changing host_files.py or any installed host
